findings: November 7, 2026 specifies Revolut account holders using stored Revolut balance or linked cards, the Revolut app on mobile and desktop QR scanning with the app before return to the merchant site (new 7-11). May 7 described a Revolut website redirect with account authentication or first-time checkout and offered saving to non-Revolut customers after the first purchase (old 6-10). The separate May acceptance already documented device-specific redirect and QR mechanisms; the change establishes a difference in the overview and does not date the introduction of those integrations.

The stable properties include customer-initiated confirmation, wallet classification, recurring, Connect, disputes, manual capture, full and partial refunds and standard payout timing. The hub lists 30 Stripe account countries and six currencies, distinguishes customer geography, and maps GBP to the UK and EUR/RON/HUF/PLN/DKK to the non-UK country group with default EUR for other EU customers (old 12-97,147-154; new 13-98,148-155).

Enable through Dashboard for Stripe-managed method presentation in supported flows. Checkout, Payment Links, Elements, Subscriptions, Invoicing and Connect remain listed, with a separate manual acceptance guide link. November replaces the Elements quickstart link and the local-video reference with the hosted demo, without claiming new integration behavior from these links (old 89-120; new 90-120).

Refunds are asynchronous, full or partial within 180 days, and take up to five minutes to complete as documented. Stripe sends refund.updated or refund.failed for the final result; the Refund becomes succeeded or failed, and failure returns the amount to Stripe balance with an alternative refund left to the merchant. Revolut decides disputes after evidence submission; Stripe notifies by email, Dashboard and charge.dispute.created if webhooks are configured, holds the amount until resolution, and returns it or makes the debit permanent based on the decision (old 122-145; new 122-146). Browser return alone establishes no payment status, capture or payout.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/revolut-pay, the November 7 overview describes a Revolut account holder paying from Revolut balance or a linked card. On mobile Stripe opens the app for authentication and confirmation, and desktop customers scan the QR with the app before returning to the site (new raw lines 7-11). The May overview describes website redirection and first-time checkout or saving by non-Revolut users (old raw lines 6-10). The two captures retain the linked Dashboard setup and product support, customer-initiated confirmation, one-time and recurring use, manual capture support, six currencies and the detailed business-country and customer scopes. The refund can succeed or fail asynchronously, with final webhook and failure restoring the amount to Stripe balance. Disputed funds are held pending Revolut's decision (old raw lines 122-154; new raw lines 122-155). source-stripe-revolut-pay.md captures the older behavior and stable features but should qualify the shopper scope and complete the refund and dispute boundaries. Return to the merchant is distinct from a verified successful payment.
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/revolut-pay, November 7 substantively reframes the documented customer scope and adds explicit mobile-app versus desktop QR authentication to the overview (new raw lines 7-11; old raw lines 6-10). The separate May acceptance guide already describes both device paths and also has dated live-mode automatic-approval language that needs qualification. Preserve May's first-time and non-account saving claims as historical in source-stripe-revolut-pay.md. November's replacement demo URL and Elements quickstart link are navigation and presentation changes (old raw lines 98-120; new raw lines 99-120). Keep the explicit country table including Liechtenstein and Norway, default-currency and settlement/presentment wording in scope, and the stable refund and dispute deadlines, especially the 35 calendar days from evidence submission (old raw lines 122-154; new raw lines 122-155). Preserve wallet, Revolut Pay concept, acceptance, future-payment and separately dated subscription routes and reconcile reciprocal overview links.
